entry.note: Identified from the title page (arXiv:2601.07906v2, hep-th, 25 Mar 2026; header 'March 2026'): Belin, Collier, Eberhardt, Liska, Post, 'A universal sum over topologies in 3d gravity', 117 pp, 31 sections. No ref() entry, none created (tangential).

relevance.rationale: The lead was a possible bearing on the Stokes/resurgence arc (conj stokes-dt-bps-bridge, ecalle-borel-resurgence-vocabulary); the instruction was to be sceptical, and the scepticism is borne out. Read: Introduction (eq. 1.1 Z[Σ] = Σ_{∂M=Σ} Z_grav[M], the handlebody sum 1.2 over MCG(Σ_g)/H_g), §4.3 'the gravitational machine is hyperbolic' (the surgery moves preserve hyperbolicity by Thurston's hyperbolisation criterion — prime, homotopically atoroidal), §4.4 (not every hyperbolic 3-manifold is generated; acylindrical ones are excluded), §5.3 handlebody knots, §6 discussion. The object is a SUM OVER DISTINCT COMPACT HYPERBOLIC 3-MANIFOLDS with a genus-g conformal boundary, each weighted by an exact Virasoro-TQFT partition function, organised so that the boundary CFT_2 data form a consistent statistical ensemble. The folio's Stokes constant is a coefficient in the Borel-plane structure of the state integral (Teichmüller TQFT / Andersen–Kashaev / DGG) of ONE cusped knot complement S^3 ∖ K, conjecturally a DT/BPS integer of T[K]. Grep of all 31 sections: zero hits for 'Stokes', 'resurgen', 'Borel', 'state integral', 'knot complement', 'cusped'; 'Teichmüller' appears only as boundary moduli and in the bibliography. A sum over topologies is not a trans-series over the Borel-plane saddles of a single manifold, so the two 'sums over hyperbolic manifolds' are different objects and no result transfers. Shared background only: Thurston hyperbolisation (the folio cites thurston1978) and the handlebody-knot tables. Nothing in content/ or docs/audits cites Virasoro TQFT (one audit mentions Teichmüller TQFT in passing). Scope-(a): as read, supplies nothing usable to the resurgence arc; a Virasoro-TQFT-on-knot-complements bridge is not excluded by this reading, it is simply not in this paper.

proposedActions.rationale: No result attaches to the Stokes/resurgence blocks or any other block; no reference created. Re-triage only if a Virasoro-TQFT ↔ state-integral identification enters the corpus.
